card.name: Digits inside phone numbers
card.fires_on: Digit tokens in the area-code part of a phone number, such as the 0 in 1-800 or the 8 in 1-888, usually after a prompt to call for information. Strongest in poison control center numbers.

modes.label: Poison control number
modes.description: The area-code digit of the 1-800-222-1222 number given in overdose sections.

modes.label: Other contact numbers
modes.description: Digits in toll-free or regular phone numbers given for further information.
modes.example: Further information is available by telephone: 1-88<<8>>-765-474

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted tokens are unrelated, though the pole fits a phone number that continues with more digits.
card.plain: It fires on a digit inside a phone number, especially the poison control hotline in overdose sections.
evidence: Further information is available by telephone: 1-88<<8>>-765-474
